title: Tesla Roadster Demo inspired me to make a browser playground for thruster-assisted car physics
author: PerceptionCharming
selftext:
Tesla Roadster Demo showed thruster flips, jumps, and landings. I built a small browser-based playground so you can experiment with the same idea.

The thrusters are fully dynamic. In automatic mode the car always recovers and lands cleanly no matter how you throw or spin it. You can also switch to full manual control if you want to try sticking the landings yourself.

It’s a physics playground rather than a scripted demo — drive, launch, rotate, and try different stunts with real forces and momentum. Everything runs in the browser.

Link: [https://bkhan23544.github.io/roadster-thrust-lab/](https://bkhan23544.github.io/roadster-thrust-lab/)

It’s open source and built with Three.js.   
  
Feedback is welcome.
